title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 藉由降服來聆聽神，用話語釋放恩典，並為有需要的人禱告服事。
ref: 以賽亞書 51:16, 約伯記 36:32, 以弗所書 4:29
lines: You know what I do sometimes in healing meetings when I'm in other places?
你知道有時候我在其他地方的醫治聚會中會怎麼做嗎？
Sometimes we're in a healing meeting, during worship, I will sneak around and find people that need a miracle and pray for them then.
有時候我們在醫治聚會中，在敬拜時，我會溜達尋找需要神蹟的人，然後為他們禱告。
Because I know that if we wait till the official time to be healed, they'll try too hard.
因為我知道，如果我們等到正式的醫治時間，他們會太過努力。
And faith does not become evident through effort.
而信心並不是透過努力來彰顯的。
Hearing from God does not come through effort; it comes through surrender.
聆聽神的聲音不是透過努力；它是透過降服。
Faith is the product of yieldedness; it's not the product of, 'I'm determined to live for the glory of God.'
信心是順服的產物；它不是『我下定決心要為神的榮耀而活』的產物。
Yeah, sweat all you want. As soon as you get exhausted, you'll hear from God.
是啊，你想怎麼流汗努力都可以。一旦你筋疲力盡，你就會聽見神的聲音。
As soon as you finally say, 'I'm done,' then He speaks.
一旦你終於說：『我不行了』，祂就會說話。
Why? Because if He speaks when you are striving with effort, He will only reaffirm flesh and carnality, and not the genuineness of who you are in Christ.
為什麼？因為如果祂在你努力掙扎時說話，祂只會認可肉體和血氣，而不是你在基督裡真實的身分。
So let me read this verse again.
所以讓我再讀一次這節經文。
It says, 'I have put My words in your mouth; I have covered you with the shadow of My hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, "You are My people."'
經上說：『我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽上眾星，立定地的根基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。』
I didn't prepare ahead of time to find this verse, and I apologize for that.
我沒有事先準備好要找這節經文，對此我感到抱歉。
But there's a great verse in Job where Job talks about him declaring a word, and it puts a mark on someone for God to strike.
但在約伯記裡有一節很棒的經文，約伯提到宣告一句話，它就在某人身上做了一個記號，讓神來擊中。
It's like he throws out the word, and the Lord is attracted to that word.
這就像他把話語拋出去，而主就被那話語吸引。
It's actually the concept that we find in Ephesians 4, where he says, 'Let no unwholesome word proceed from your mouth.'
這實際上就是我們在以弗所書第四章看到的觀念，那裡說：『污穢的言語一句不可出口。』
Which is a great standard for all prophetic people.
這對所有先知性的人來說是一個很棒的標準。
'Let no unwholesome word proceed from your mouth, but only such a word as is good for edification according to the need of the moment, so that it will give grace to those who hear.'
『污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，好將恩典賜給聽見的人。』
What is grace? It is divine favor.
什麼是恩典？恩典是神聖的恩寵。
Think with me: only speak edifying words that it might give grace.
跟我一起想：只說造就人的話，好讓它能賜下恩典。
恩典是什麼？是神聖的恩寵。
You choose who to encourage, and your word of encouragement is something that God approves of.
你選擇要鼓勵誰，而你鼓勵的話語是神所認可的。
And He pours favor into the person you've chosen to encourage.
然後祂將恩寵傾注在你選擇鼓勵的那個人身上。
You come to somebody you do business with, a neighbor, you just go over, you just encourage them.
你走到一個跟你做生意的人、一個鄰居面前，你就是走過去，你就是鼓勵他們。
You just give them an encouraging word.
你就是給他們一句鼓勵的話。
You just tell them, 'This is what I see God doing in your life. It's a beautiful thing.'
你就是告訴他們：『這是我看見神在你生命中正在做的事。這是一件美好的事。』
Or, 'I just want to encourage you; you're so gifted in this area.'
或者，『我只是想鼓勵你；你在這方面非常有恩賜。』
What are you doing? You're just planting a word.
你在做什麼？你只不過是在栽種一句話。
And God is going to put favor right there, put grace right there, pour the grace in right there.
而神就要把恩寵放在那裡，把恩典放在那裡，將恩典傾注在那裡。
Why? 'Because one of My own distributed a word of encouragement there; I've got to back it up.'
為什麼？『因為我自己的孩子在那裡散播了一句鼓勵的話；我必須要支持它。』
You know how we started the prophetic in Weaverville years ago?
你們知道多年前我們在威弗維爾（Weaverville）是如何開始先知性服事的嗎？
那裡當時完全沒有先知性，歸零。
There wasn't a prophetic mouse, there wasn't a prophetic flea; it was zero when we moved there.
那裡沒有一隻先知性的老鼠，也沒有一隻先知性的跳蚤；當我們搬去的時候，那是零。
So I'd get men to sit around a table, and I'd turn to the one on my right.
所以我會找些弟兄圍坐在桌旁，然後轉向我右邊的那位。
I'd say, 'If Jesus were to walk in the room right now, what do you think He'd say?'
我會說：『如果耶穌現在走進這個房間，你覺得祂會說什麼？』
And they'd go, 'I think He'd say...'
他們就會說：『我覺得祂會說……』
I'd go to the next one, go all the way around the room.
我會繼續問下一個，就這樣繞著房間問一圈。
And after we got all the way around the room, I'd say, 'Do you realize that you all just prophesied?'
當我們繞完房間一圈後，我會說：『你們知道你們剛剛都發預言了嗎？』
And they'd go, 'Huh, is it that easy?'
然後他們會說：『咦，有這麼簡單嗎？』
See, when you strive is when you miss it.
看吧，當你努力掙扎時，你就會錯失它。
It's when you're relaxing in who you are, abiding in His presence, abiding in His voice.
而是當你在自己的身分中放鬆，常在祂的同在裡，常在祂的聲音中時。
It becomes very natural to speak words that are life-giving.
說出賜生命的話語就會變得很自然。
Put your hands in front of you.
Let me pray for this prophetic anointing to be released.
讓我為釋放這先知性的恩膏來禱告。
Lord, I do pray for that.
I pray that You would increase the mantle of the prophetic.
我祈求祢增加先知性的外袍。
God, help us to keep it pure, to keep it real, but to serve our city well. Thank you, amen.
神啊，幫助我們保持它的純潔，保持真實，並能好好服事我們的城市。謝謝祢，阿們。
Okay, if you'd hold your places for just a moment.
好的，請大家稍微留在原位一下。
I know in a crowd this size, we always have people who don't know the Lord.
我知道在這麼多人的群眾中，我們總會有人還不認識主。
And if there's anyone here today that would just say, 'Bill, I don't want to leave this place until I know that I am right with God.'
如果今天這裡有任何人願意說：『比爾，我不想離開這個地方，直到我知道我與神的關係是對的。』
'Until I know that I've been forgiven of sin and brought into His personal family.'
『直到我知道我的罪已得赦免，並被帶入祂親自建立的家中。』
If you would be willing to say that, I want you just to put your hand up where you are, because we're just going to pray.
如果你願意這麼說，我希望你就在原位舉起手，因為我們就是要來禱告。
Just put your hand right here, we have one.
把你的手舉起來——就在這裡，我們看到一位。
Anybody else? Just put your hand up real quick. Another one back here.
還有其他人嗎？趕快舉起你的手。後面還有一位。
Just say, 'Bill, I don't want to leave till I know I'm right with God.'
只要說：『比爾，我不想離開，直到我知道我與神的關係是對的。』
I know we have two overflow rooms as well.
我知道我們還有兩個副堂。
For those in the overflow rooms, do the same thing.
在副堂裡的人，也請做同樣的事。
In fact, this is what I want to say: the two that put your hands up, if you just come right down over here.
事實上，這是我想要說的：那兩位舉手的，請你們直接走到這裡來。
And if there's any others, come quickly over here.
如果有其他人，也請趕快走到這裡來。
We have some people that we know and love and trust that are going to pray for you.
我們有一些我們認識、所愛且信任的人，他們會為你們禱告。
I need our Freedom Team down here.
我需要我們的自由事工團隊到前面來。
And if you're in one of the other two overflow rooms, please just make your way from there to here right now.
如果你在另外兩個副堂裡，請現在就從那裡走到這裡來。
And we've got a group of people that are going to pray for you.
我們有一群人會為你們禱告。
All right, this is the most important thing that's happened all day, right here.
好，今天一整天發生最重要的事情，就在這裡。
This is the most time-sensitive issue of the day, right here.
這是今天最具有時效性（急迫）的事情，就在這裡。
So we're going to pray that the Lord would touch them so deeply and so profoundly.
所以我們要禱告主會如此深刻且深遠地觸摸他們。
I need some more of our Freedom Team down here.
我需要更多自由事工團隊的人到前面來。
Also, I want to have our ministry team come to the front.
同時，我要請我們的服事團隊到前面來。
If everyone else could hold your place for just a moment, this does help us out.
如果其他人能稍微留在原位一下，這對我們很有幫助。
We want to open it up for people to receive the miracle in your body, the miracle in your life.
我們想開放讓大家領受你身體上的神蹟、你生命中的神蹟。
It's just become normal for Jesus to touch and heal people.
耶穌觸摸並醫治人，這已經成為常態了。
So we encourage you, come be a part of that.
所以我們鼓勵你，來成為這其中的一份子。
And B, why don't you explain what to do and how to do it? All right.
而Ｂ，你來解釋一下該做什麼以及如何做吧？好的。
